voice_notes: Wigfrid is an actress who has vanished into the role of a valkyrie. She speaks in mock-archaic English ('tis, hath, thou, mine), invokes Odin, Loki, Hel and Valhalla, and thinks in terms of foes, allies, glory and meat. Now and then the actress shows through ('I have my own costu- that is, warrior's garb!', 'This play is in need of actors.'). She already reads the Codex as a drama ('A tragic tale of woe and misery!') and calls nightmare fuel 'The fuel of darkness!'. PT-BR keeps her feminine and gives her archaic tu forms in commands ('Revela-te, demônio!', 'Retornaste!'). It calls the fuel 'O combustível da escuridão!'. ZH writes plain, vivid exclamations and switches to 汝/吾 for high drama ('看吾斩断汝暗影干涉的爪子！'). It renders the fuel as '暗黑燃料！'. RU uses bardic inverted word order ('Огни Вальхаллы вижу я?', 'Вернулся ты!'), feminine verb forms and 'Топливо тьмы!'. Revised: theatre references cut (0.6% of her vanilla lines), archaic phrasing and battle talk kept near her rates (about 12% each).

line_notes.codex: Keeps the callback to her vanilla Codex line (official wording in each language) and turns it into a warrior's boast instead of an acting joke.
line_notes.codex_needsfuel: Her appetite: the empty book is starving; uses her official name for nightmare fuel.
line_notes.no_max_sanity: A curt battlefield 'Hold!' and a plain admission that her mind can carry no more shades than the ones already out make it read clearly as 'can't summon more right now'.
line_notes.shadow_mine: Her vanilla greeting 'Health and strength to you, %s!' aimed at her own shadow (official wording).
line_notes.shadow_other: A warrior's charge to an ally's shade, without the heavy archaic phrasing.
